name: simulation
notes: 200 seeded cases per property; one-off amounts £0.01–£3,000 on a random horizon day; income delays of 1–10 days on the first payday in the horizon.
SIM-6 checks that only a contiguous window starting at the payday changes, that it spans at least the delay, and that the end balance is unchanged when the pay lands in horizon.

SIM-11 projects a goal (target £0.01–£10,000, 30–300 days out, residual funding): the shortfall must equal target − P50 progress to the penny, the projection must repeat exactly, the required monthly change must be whole £10 steps, and P50 progress must equal the forecast's own target-cycle low above the buffer for targets on the day before a payday (half the cases) whenever under 45% of paths dip below the buffer (otherwise the zero floor reaches the median and the two may differ).
